result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 7 against the full Epic 5 tech design and test plan, inspected the lower-band inspection/reporting implementation across workbench, compaction, rollout, PI command, and script surfaces, and ran the story/epic gates plus a targeted repro for the unstable gate result.

newFindings.title: The Story 7 E2E proof does not exercise the actual /lh-lower-band-status operator surface
newFindings.evidence: Story 7 scope and DoD require a narrow proof that the real operator command surface can reach lower-band inspection output (story lines 19-29 and 193-200), and the non-TC decided test points that proof at tests/context-steward/e2e-cli.e2e.test.ts. The current test body at tests/context-steward/e2e-cli.e2e.test.ts:737-745 invokes node/tsx against scripts/inspect-lower-band-status.ts instead of invoking the registered PI command /lh-lower-band-status, so the required outer command-surface proof is still missing.
requirementIds: Definition of Done: Narrow E2E proves the operator command surface can reach lower-band inspection output
Story 7 Scope: Narrow E2E/CLI proof that the real operator command surface can reach lower-band inspection output

newFindings.title: The required story gate is currently non-deterministic
newFindings.evidence: A standalone `npm run verify` failed in tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts at line 1513 when `production prompt projection does not reset when PI leaf advances during ordinary appends` observed `after.thread.status.tokenCounting?.status` as undefined. Without any code changes, the same verify step passed when rerun inside `npm run verify-all`, and the named test also passed when rerun in isolation. That leaves the required story-gate truth untrusted for handoff.
requirementIds: Definition of Done: npm run verify passes

gatesRun.command: npm run verify (rerun inside npm run verify-all)
node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern "production prompt projection does not reset when PI leaf advances during ordinary appends" tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts

openQuestions: Why did the full-suite `npm run verify` fail once in `tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts` while the same test and the rerun inside `npm run verify-all` both passed?
additionalObservations: No material fake-adapter/shim/placeholder runtime path was found in the inspected Story 7 production surfaces; the PI command and helper script both delegate to `WorkbenchQueryService`, and legacy placeholder chunk state is only blocked/reported.
Service-tier Story 7 coverage passed for lower-band readiness, failure reporting, compact blocker reporting, catch-up visibility, and non-evaluative output.
The isolated repro command for the flaky capture-service test passed, which points to suite-order or race sensitivity rather than a deterministic single-test failure.
